summary.name: 1440: Quill News Digest
summary.one_liner: Quill News is a free iOS, iPad and Mac news app that condenses top stories from many publishers into short summaries and daily audio podcasts.
use_cases: Catch up on the day's top news in about five minutes
Get a morning news briefing while doing routines
Listen to daily audio news podcasts
Scan multiple publishers' coverage of one story
Find less biased summaries of current events
summary.what_it_does: The app compiles top news stories from many publishers, including ABC, NBC News, MSNBC, USA Today, Time, AP, Reuters and The Verge, and summarizes them into short paragraphs. It publishes a daily edition that users can read in compact or expanded layouts. It also offers daily audio podcasts with commentators discussing the news. The developer says the app aims to present facts without bias, and a user review says it does not track users. The page states the app is free.
notable: AI-generated summaries of top stories from many publishers
Developer Tyler Schultz responds to feedback, per user reviews
caveats: Requires iOS 18.6 or later, iPadOS 18.6 or later, or macOS 15.6 or later with an Apple M1 chip or later
Podcast upload times are reported by a user as inconsistent
Developer has not indicated accessibility features
